$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopRun = the COMPLETE local run record (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.7). Kept ALONGSIDE loop-run-summary.schema.json per this work package's merged-artifact-list instruction — these are two distinct objects, not one object with an optional-fields toggle: LoopRun is the full, unredacted, phone-local record; LoopRunSummary (loop-run-summary.schema.json) is the strict, already-allowlisted-and-denylisted-but-still-unbucketed middle stage a Share Result flow builds FROM this record; LoopResultShare (loop-result-share.schema.json) is the final, bucketed, consented, optionally-signed artifact that actually leaves the phone. `runState` MUST be exactly the 17-state machine LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §9 requires (CREATED, PREFLIGHT, WAITING_BINDING, WAITING_AUTHORITY, READY, RUNNING, WAITING_USER [non-terminal], SUSPENDED, CANCELLING, SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED, SUCCEEDED_UNVERIFIED, STOPPED_BUDGET, STOPPED_POLICY, FAILED_SAFE, FAILED_SIDE_EFFECTS_POSSIBLE, TARGET_STATE_UNKNOWN, CANCELLED) — state names copied VERBATIM from that document's §9 transition table, not re-derived or approximated; a conflict between this schema's enum and that document's table is this schema's error, and the document wins. The 8 terminal values here are BY-NAME-IDENTICAL to LoopDefinitionContracts.kt's pre-existing `TerminalRunState` enum (a node's own failure-to-terminal-state mapping, §4) and to this same work package's own `TerminalRunState` $def duplicated in loop-result-share.schema.json / loop-run-summary.schema.json — one closed 8-value vocabulary, three duplicated encodings, per this corpus's standalone-schema convention.
title: LoopRun
description: The complete, unredacted, phone-local record of one concrete execution of a LoopDraft or installed LoopRelease (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.7) against one binding profile, input set, authority set, and engine version. Nothing in this document is redacted, bucketed, or allowlisted — that happens downstream, first at LoopRunSummary (loop-run-summary.schema.json) and then at LoopResultShare (loop-result-share.schema.json). This document MUST NOT itself be uploaded, exported, or shared by any automated path (FB-RAT-MKT-008, no phone telemetry) — only the explicit Share Result flow (LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §3) may derive a LoopRunSummary from it, under explicit user action.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

runId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this run (FB-RAT-COM-002), stable across every RunState transition of the same execution.

definitionDigest.description: The semanticDigest (semantic-digest.v1.json) of the exact LoopDefinition this run executed — the value LOOP-VERIFY-002 ties a SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED claim to ('a passing result tied to this run's inputs, digest, and artifacts').

sourceRef.description: Which draft revision or installed release this run executed against (§2.7 'one concrete execution of one draft or installed release') — the same draft-or-release union loop-semantic-diff.schema.json's BaseRevisionRef already models (duplicated locally here, not cross-file $ref'd).

bindingProfileRef.description: Pointer to the binding-profile.schema.json document resolved for this run — the device-specific resolution of the definition's abstract slots to actual models/repos/targets/devices/secrets/policies/budgets.

parameters.description: Typed input values bound to this run at READY (§9), matching the definition's declared input JSON Schema. Full and unredacted — this is exactly the category loop-run-summary.schema.json/loop-result-share.schema.json's default-excluded list drops ('prompt and model response content' MAY appear inside here for a model-inference node's own recorded input; never carried forward downstream).

targetDecisions.description: Which concrete ExecutionTargetType was chosen for each binding slot or node with target flexibility, and by whom/when — the raw material a share-time localCloudRatio (loop-run-summary.schema.json §4) is computed FROM, not itself carried forward downstream (host identity/displayName never appear here beyond the coarse ExecutionTargetType).

eventLog.description: The full event log — one entry per §9 transition table row actually taken during this run, in order. This is the 'full event log' this work package's task brief asks for; LoopRunSummary/LoopResultShare never carry this array at all (they carry only the terminal outcome).

nodeAttempts.description: Per-node execution attempts (one or more per node — retries produce additional entries with an incremented attemptNumber, §4 retry policy).

userInterventions.description: Every point a human acted on this run: a WAITING_USER decision supplied, a budget extension approved, an authority grant approved/declined, a cancel/suspend/resume request (§9, §18).

outputs.description: Full, unredacted primary result, artifacts, receipts, human-readable summary, and warnings (§16). Null only while the run has not yet produced any output (non-terminal, early states).

terminalReason.description: Populated exactly when runState is one of the 8 terminal values — see this schema's allOf. `category` MUST be one of the closed TerminalReasonCategory values below, grounded in §9's own per-row terminal-reason text; never a free-text-only reason.

runState.description: THE central field. LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §9's 17-state machine, verbatim.

authorityGrants.description: Grant IDs (schemas/authority/grant.schema.json Grant.grantId) confirmed during this run's WAITING_AUTHORITY transition (§10) — referenced by ID only, matching loop-installation.schema.json's identical field-level convention for the same reason (the authority domain owns the full Grant shape).

sideEffectState.description: Mirrors dev.fonebrew.contracts.common's SideEffectState/ErrorEnvelope.sideEffectState vocabulary, duplicated locally per this corpus's standalone-schema convention. UNKNOWN MUST be used rather than guessing NONE (FB-RAT-COM-007) — directly relevant to FAILED_SIDE_EFFECTS_POSSIBLE and TARGET_STATE_UNKNOWN (§9). Null only for a run still short of any side-effecting step.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this run entered CREATED (FB-RAT-COM-004).

updatedAtUtc.description: UTC instant of the most recent runState transition. Null only for a record still exactly at CREATED.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: A terminal runState MUST carry a non-null terminalReason (§9's 'Terminal states MUST include a terminal reason...').
A non-terminal runState MUST NOT carry a terminalReason — a run that has not stopped cannot have already recorded why it stopped.

BaseRevisionRef.description: Same shape as loop-semantic-diff.schema.json's BaseRevisionRef — duplicated locally, not cross-file $ref'd, per this corpus's convention.

ActorClass.description: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §15's exact actor-class vocabulary, duplicated locally.

NodeCategory.description: §4 Amendment 1's eight node categories, duplicated locally.

TerminalRunStateValue.description: The 8 terminal values of RunState below, extracted as their own enum purely so this schema's allOf can test runState membership without repeating the list — NOT a separate wire field. Used only inside this document's own if/then; the actual wire enum a producer emits is RunState.

RunState.description: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §9's 17 required run states verbatim: 9 non-terminal (CREATED, PREFLIGHT, WAITING_BINDING, WAITING_AUTHORITY, READY, RUNNING, WAITING_USER, SUSPENDED, CANCELLING) followed by 8 terminal (SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED, SUCCEEDED_UNVERIFIED, STOPPED_BUDGET, STOPPED_POLICY, FAILED_SAFE, FAILED_SIDE_EFFECTS_POSSIBLE, TARGET_STATE_UNKNOWN, CANCELLED). WAITING_USER is non-terminal (Amendment §2 — a change from the base pack's LoopResult, where it was terminal); CANCELLED is new relative to the base pack. Do not re-derive or approximate this list; a conflict between this enum and §9's table is this schema's error, and the document wins.

TerminalReasonCategory.description: A closed, coarse vocabulary this schema authors from §9's own per-transition 'Receipt'/terminal-reason text (one value per distinct terminal-reason phrase in that table's rows) — schema-authoring work explicitly invited by §9 ('Terminal states MUST include a terminal reason... category, never a free-text reason' per LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §4). New normative vocabulary, not itself a re-derivation of an existing registry list; a future LOOP-* rule code MAY be added to loop-validation-rules.v1.json to make individual categories machine-checkable, not done here.

detail.description: Human/diagnostic detail beyond the closed category — e.g. which exact budget dimension for a BUDGET_* category (§18). Free text, for local diagnostics only; never carried into loop-run-summary/loop-result-share beyond the closed category.

targetId.description: The nodeId or bindingSlotId this target choice concerns.

fromState.description: Null only for the initiating event (§9's '(none — initiation)' row into CREATED).

description.description: The §9 table's 'Event' column text for the transition actually taken.

outcome.description: Null while the attempt is still in flight (no endedAtUtc yet).

ArtifactRef.description: Duplicated locally from schemas/common/artifact-ref.schema.json per this corpus's standalone-schema convention.

RunOutputs.description: §16: primary typed result, artifacts, receipts and verifier evidence, human-readable summary, warnings and unresolved uncertainty. Full and unredacted.
